title: Balance & packages
manualCreditHint: Balances are credited manually by the site administrator.
noMembership: Your base group benefits currently apply.
purchaseHint: Renewing the same package extends its expiry. Different packages cannot overlap. A group change requires signing in again and recreating API tokens.
uncertain: The previous result is uncertain. Retry the same request to confirm it; it cannot charge twice.
loginRequired: Your package is active. Sign in again after the group change; existing API tokens were revoked and must be recreated.
loadError: Could not load billing information. Please retry.
purchaseError: The purchase result could not be confirmed.
unavailable: Balance and packages are currently unavailable
groupTermsHint: Packages use their group’s current benefits. Group changes apply to existing members. Images and links remain after expiry; exceeding the base quota prevents new uploads.
name: Package name
saveError: Could not save. Refresh and retry.
soldTermsHint: Sold packages keep their group and duration. Create another package to change them. Archived packages cannot be reopened.
invalidMoney: Enter a valid amount with at most two decimal places.
adjustHint: All adjustments record the operator and reason. Balances cannot go negative. Reverse an incorrect adjustment to correct it.
reverseHint: Add a complete inverse adjustment without deleting history. Package purchases cannot be reversed here.
pendingAdjustment: The previous adjustment is uncertain. Retry with the original identifier.
adminGroupOverride: Changing this user’s group or role ends their active package without automatically returning the balance.
